summary: 28-year-old hiker took a small fall on the Ute Trail on the east side of Aspen Mountain, sustaining moderate non-life-threatening injuries; MRA and four other agencies carried the patient down to an awaiting ambulance.
location: Ute Trail, east side of Aspen Mountain
notes: Patient contact ~12:35 PM, transfer to ambulance 2:46 PM; 22 rescuers from five agencies in the field.
